activation_statement: This artifact does not seal, consume, or reference by digest any specific activation. It defines the exact mutation bytes/operands that a future one-use activation for run_id gate-b-31f4fa2e-e697-4c3a-b00e-98626f867811 attempt_number 1 must bind before Gate-B runtime mutation is authorized. No activation is consumed by this artifact.

EVIDENCE_BACKUP.on_mismatch: STOP before touching any host authority object
steps: copy original var-lib-quant\x2dp0.mount bytes verbatim into /var/lib/quant-p0-qualification/gate-b-evidence/gate-b-31f4fa2e-e697-4c3a-b00e-98626f867811/1/original-var-lib-quant-p0.mount.bak (never edit original file in place)
record sha256 of the backed-up bytes and assert it equals sha256:fb37ed643fcb237fcb0c3ec54ee9ceada1e376ee88cc16f39cff47ef68a19875
record current nft ruleset digest (nft list ruleset | sha256sum) into /var/lib/quant-p0-qualification/gate-b-evidence/gate-b-31f4fa2e-e697-4c3a-b00e-98626f867811/1/pre-mutation-nft-ruleset.sha256
fsync every written evidence file and its parent directory

INSTALL_NETWORK_GUARD.on_mismatch: STOP; do not proceed to reservoir switch; leave guard installed or roll back per section ROLLBACK_SANITIZATION
steps: nft list table inet quant_gate_b must succeed and print the table
assert an `hook output` chain exists in that table
assert `tcp dport 443 drop` (or equivalent compiled rule) is present
INSTALL_NETWORK_GUARD.verification_mechanism: repository-side/host-side rule inspection only; no real SEC network request is ever used to verify this rule

checks: resolve live FragmentPath of var-lib-quant\x2dp0.mount and read exact bytes
current /var/lib/quant-p0 backing identity matches accepted rebind anchor
current /opt/quant/var binding matches accepted rebind anchor (unchanged, not mutated)
no existing `table inet quant_gate_b` present (nft list tables | grep -qv quant_gate_b)
synthetic reservoir path /mnt/quant-data/gate-b-synthetic/gate-b-31f4fa2e-e697-4c3a-b00e-98626f867811/state does not exist
PRE_MUTATION_VERIFICATION.on_mismatch: STOP; no mutation performed; report exact mismatched check
PRE_MUTATION_VERIFICATION.precondition: requires exactly one consumed activation matching run_id/attempt_number above; performed immediately before first mutation, never by this repository-side pack

ROLLBACK_SANITIZATION.authorization_rule: no systemctl start quant-sec-capture.service is authorized by rollback completion alone
ROLLBACK_SANITIZATION.retention_rule: retain the synthetic reservoir and every evidence file written under /var/lib/quant-p0-qualification/gate-b-evidence/gate-b-31f4fa2e-e697-4c3a-b00e-98626f867811/1 permanently; never delete lifecycle evidence to present a clean state
steps: hash the synthetic reservoir tree and store as restricted evidence under /var/lib/quant-p0-qualification/gate-b-evidence/gate-b-31f4fa2e-e697-4c3a-b00e-98626f867811/1/post-campaign-synthetic-reservoir.sha256

restore exact original bytes from /var/lib/quant-p0-qualification/gate-b-evidence/gate-b-31f4fa2e-e697-4c3a-b00e-98626f867811/1/original-var-lib-quant-p0.mount.bak to /etc/systemd/system/var-lib-quant\x2dp0.mount
verify original qualifying reservoir identity/inventory matches pre-mutation evidence
nft list table inet quant_gate_b must fail/return absent after guard rollback

SYNTHETIC_RESERVOIR_SWITCH.on_mismatch: STOP; do not begin destructive lifecycle work; proceed to ROLLBACK_SANITIZATION
postconditions: /opt/quant/var resolves through the synthetic reservoir path chain
preserved qualifying backing (/dev/sdb[/quant-p0-state]) remains distinct and untouched
steps: systemctl stop var-lib-quant\x2dp0.mount (detach current /var/lib/quant-p0 view; original backing bytes are not deleted or altered)
atomically install exact sealed bytes (sha256 sha256:ef9e43e7674270ed3977a8e89c54c0e07c8ac6ec1e32566c3441d04438fd507e) at /etc/systemd/system/var-lib-quant\x2dp0.mount

repository_side: sha256 of each pack artifact matches pack_artifacts.*.sha256 exactly

quant-gate-b-egress.nft parses with `nft -c -f` and defines table inet quant_gate_b, hook output, and `tcp dport 443 drop`, with no accept/allow rule referencing port 443 and no second chain/jump that can bypass it
var-lib-quant-p0.synthetic.mount.unit Where= equals /var/lib/quant-p0 and What= equals the fixed synthetic_reservoir path exactly
no file in this pack or this commit modifies src/, the frozen V4 candidate tree, or quant-sec-capture.service
target_host_only: actual nft kernel behavior (packet-level TCP/443 deny) — not provable from repository CI
live FragmentPath and byte-exact match of the currently loaded var-lib-quant\x2dp0.mount unit
live resolution of the escaped systemd unit backing /mnt/quant-data (assumed conventional name mnt-quant\x2ddata.mount; must be reconfirmed live)
live boot ID / NTP / service state freshness at the moment of activation consumption
actual mount topology postconditions (findmnt) after the reservoir switch
